acceptance_criteria.criterion: handleListProjects() returns an array of project summaries (may be empty)
handleGetProject() throws NOT_FOUND for an unknown slug
handleGetWorkPackage() throws NOT_FOUND for an unknown WP ID
handleDeleteProject() throws FORBIDDEN when the project status is not COMPLETE
handleDeleteProject() removes the project directory from disk when status is COMPLETE
handleDeleteProject() returns { deleted: true, slug } on success
handleUpdateConfig() rejects a body with ledger_root set (strips or ignores it — does not persist it)
handleUpdateConfig() rejects invalid types (e.g., max_handoff_depth: 'foo') with VALIDATION_ERROR
handleGetConfig() returns the current in-memory config (matching what was last written)
All handlers are exported as named exports

summary: Created mcp-server/gui/api.ts with all 7 handler functions: handleListProjects, handleGetProject, handleListWorkPackages, handleGetWorkPackage, handleDeleteProject, handleGetConfig, handleUpdateConfig
Structured error type ApiError exported with code/message/details fields
handleUpdateConfig uses GuiConfigPartialSchema (omits ledger_root) — read-only field correctly stripped
handleGetConfig returns getConfig() from in-memory cache (no disk read)
handleDeleteProject guards with meta.status === COMPLETE before fs.rm()
All handlers exported as named exports

comments.note: gui/api.ts is a standalone module outside src/ and is not compiled by the main tsc (tsconfig rootDir: ./src). It will be compiled by a separate tsconfig or run directly with tsx as part of the GUI server process (WP-003).

No unit tests exist yet for gui/api.ts handler functions. Integration tests will be added as part of WP-003 or a dedicated test WP. The acceptance criteria are verified by code inspection only for this WP.

handleDeleteProject uses meta! (definite assignment assertion) after a try-catch where the catch always throws. This is safe but slightly inelegant; an alternative is to use a single async IIFE or restructure with a helper.

summary: All 10 acceptance criteria verified by code inspection
Zod strip behavior correctly handles ledger_root in PUT body (AC #7)
handleDeleteProject COMPLETE guard is checked before any destructive action
Error shape is consistent across all handlers: { code, message, details? }

comments.note: AC #7 (ledger_root stripping) is satisfied by Zod's default strip behavior: GuiConfigPartialSchema omits ledger_root, so Zod strips it silently. If body is { ledger_root: 'foo', auto_handoff_enabled: true }, only { auto_handoff_enabled: true } is parsed and persisted.
Coverage gap: no automated tests for gui/api.ts handler functions. All criteria verified by code inspection only. Integration tests should be added in WP-003 or a future dedicated test WP.

comments.note: ApiError class with typed code/message/details is clean and consistent. The never-returning helper functions (notFound, forbidden, validationError) make control flow explicit and prevent dead code after throws.
No circular dependency risks: gui/api.ts only imports from src/ modules and does not create any back-references.
